explanation: In the play, King Dushyanta forgets his bride Shakuntala because of a curse. A German translation in 1791 so impressed Goethe that he wrote a short poem in its praise.

claims.text: Kalidasa wrote the Sanskrit play The Recognition of Shakuntala (Abhijnanashakuntalam).
Valmiki, Tulsidas and Kabir did not write The Recognition of Shakuntala.
In the play, King Dushyanta forgets Shakuntala because of a sage's curse.
Georg Forster's German translation of Shakuntala was published in 1791.
Goethe wrote a short poem praising Shakuntala after reading it in translation.
